text: I can write cache-aside read and write code from memory, including the TTL and the delete on write.
I can explain how read-through differs from cache-aside and how it can coalesce concurrent misses.
I can explain the write latency and consistency limits of write-through.
I can calculate how many writes a write-behind cache could lose on a crash, given the write rate and flush interval.
I can name a workload where write-around beats write-through and say why.
I can pick and justify a read and write strategy for each kind of data in a design.
